evidence.name: Screen field: Selected item look
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Selected item look" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Selected item look
sections.description: How a choice looks once tapped — background, border, corner radius, and optional gradient. Make it clearly distinct from the unselected look (an accent border or filled background) so visitors get instant confirmation; weak feedback here causes hesitation and drop-off. Your theme's accent color is a reliable choice.
